newsitem.title: USA: First Empire completes securities offering.
newsitem.headline: First Empire completes securities offering.

text.p: First Empire State Corp said on Friday that it has completed an offering of $100 million of preferred securities through First Empire Capital Trust II, a trust formed by the company.

The 30-year offering of 8.277 percent fixed-rate, cumulative capital securities provides investors with call protection for 10 years, the company said. Preferential cash distributions will be paid semiannually, beginning December 1, 1997.
The trust was formed solely to issue tax-advantaged securities and advance the proceeds to First Empire by purchasing its junior subordinated debt, First Empire said.
The issue will qualify as Tier 1 capital for First Empire and be available for general corporate purposes, the company said.
Payments on the junior subordinated debt, which are in turn passed through the trust to the preferred holders, will be serviced through existing liquidity and cash flow sources of First Empire.
